recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if a future build reintroduces sdf-7 or a schematron XPath for the same StructureDefinition URL rule.
issue_request: FHIR-12686 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core StructureDefinition schemas/schematrons. It asked to correct sdf-7's schematron XPath so the logical-model exception used f:kind/@value = 'logical' instead of f:derivation/@value = 'logical'.
initial_application: Git commit 1553de3d6d748b5151eb605c290e71ad10b0ce1f, the git-svn mirror of svn revision 11394 noted in Jira, changed the StructureDefinition spreadsheet XPath from the derivation-based logical check to f:kind/@value = 'logical'. The generated STU3 historical profile in tools/history/release3 also contains the corrected f:kind XPath.
additional_context: The old spreadsheet source was later removed, and FHIR-17185/GF#17185 explicitly dropped sdf-7 while updating adjacent StructureDefinition invariants. Current source/fhir.ini still lists StructureDefinition as an active resource, but the current StructureDefinition source no longer contains sdf-7 or the obsolete schematron XPath. A 2016 Zulip thread corroborates the original defect, and Confluence searches found no conflicting decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit on the combined branch. No source change is warranted because the requested XPath correction is already in the applicable history and the current build no longer has the old sdf-7 XPath target.

related_jiras.note: Published/Persuasive later StructureDefinition change that explicitly dropped sdf-7 and updated adjacent invariants, explaining why the old XPath target is absent from current source.
